parameters.query: SELECT agent_id, agent_name, agent_type, endpoint, health_url, capabilities, intents, priority, weight, heartbeat_ttl_seconds, metadata, flag, log_path, status, n8n_workflow_id, registered_at, last_heartbeat, updated_at FROM public.registered_agents WHERE status = 'active' AND endpoint IS NOT NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) AND (last_heartbeat IS NULL OR last_heartbeat + (heartbeat_ttl_seconds * INTERVAL '1 second') > NOW()) ORDER BY priority ASC, weight DESC, last_heartbeat DESC NULLS LAST, agent_id ASC;

parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all().map(item => { const row = item.json ?? {}; const caps = row.capabilities?.list ?? row.capabilities ?? []; return { ...row, capabilities: Array.isArray(caps) ? caps : [], intents: Array.isArray(row.intents) ? row.intents : [], metadata: row.metadata && typeof row.metadata === 'object' ? row.metadata : {}, flag: Number.isFinite(Number(row.flag)) ? Number(row.flag) : 0, log_path: row.log_path && typeof row.log_path === 'object' ? row.log_path : {}, status: row.status ?? 'active' }; }); return [{ json: { items } }];
